name: 开心庆祝
prompt: A very happy person makes three joyful little jumps straight up in place, cheering with both arms spread wide in a broad upward V. Both hands stay far apart, much wider than the shoulders, never meeting above the head. Open both arms out diagonally upward, bend the elbows down between jumps, then spread them wide upward again. Land softly in the same spot and relax the arms. No turning, no walking, no arms held together, no surrender pose.
